title: Journal entry frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter every journal entry carries. Only the fields the tool cannot do without are required; the rest are typed when present. Extra fields are allowed so a consuming repository can add its own.

date.description: The entry date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must match the date in the filename.

status.description: superseded is set on the older entry of a continuation pair.

source.description: URL of the article or tutorial an entry summarises.

refinement_ticket.description: Requires a '## Proposed Ticket Description' section.

jira_ticket.description: Requires a '## Jira Comment Draft' section.

continues_from.description: Relative path of the earlier entry. Requires a '## Related Entries' section.

continued_by.description: Relative path of the later entry. Requires a 'Superseded' banner.
